metadata.question: In 2021, did the Antarctic ozone hole reach a size of 18 million square kilometers?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use OMI (Ozone Monitoring Instrument) or similar satellite data to measure ozone hole extent - Focus on 2021, specifically September-October (peak ozone hole season in Southern Hemisphere) - Antarctic region (typically 60°S to 90°S, or define around South Pole) - Ozone hole is typically defined as area where total column ozone (TCO) < 220 DU (Dobson Units) 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed; we're looking at total column ozone data which is retrieved above clouds - Filter for valid ozone measurements 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - A: If maximum ozone hole area in 2021 ≥ 18 million km² - B: If maximum ozone hole area in 2021 < 18 million km² - C1: If no ozone data available for 2021 - C3: If calculation results in None/NaN or invalid values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Antarctic region (60°S to 90°S) const antarcticGeometry = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, -90, 180, -60]); // 2021 ozone hole season (September-October) const startDate = '2021-09-01'; const endDate = '2021-10-31'; // Load OMI total column ozone data const omiCollection = ee.ImageCollection('TOMS/MERGED') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(antarcticGeometry); const collectionSize = omiCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`OMI Images in 2021 Sept-Oct: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No OMI data found. Trying alternative source...'); // Fallback: Try AURA OMI Level 3 const omiL3 = ee.ImageCollection('OMINRT_3') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(antarcticGeometry); const sizeL3 = omiL3.size().getInfo(); console.log(`OMI L3 Images: ${sizeL3}`); if (sizeL3 === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } } // Use the best available collection let workingCollection = collectionSize > 0 ? omiCollection : ee.ImageCollection('OMINRT_3').filterDate(startDate, endDate).filterBounds(antarcticGeometry); // Calculate ozone hole area (TCO < 220 DU) const ozoneMask = workingCollection.map(function(img) { // Get TCO band const tco = img.select('ozone'); // Create binary mask where ozone < 220 DU const holeArea = tco.lt(220); return holeArea.set('date', img.get('system:time_start')); }); // Count pixels in ozone hole for each day const dailyCounts = ozoneMask.map(function(img) { const pixelCount = img.reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.count(), antarcticGeometry, 30000 // 30km resolution for OMI-equivalent ).get('ozone'); return ee.Feature(null, { date: img.get('date'), holePixels: pixelCount }); }); // Get maximum pixel count (maximum ozone hole extent) const maxHolePixels = dailyCounts.aggregate_max('holePixels').getInfo(); console.log(`Max hole pixels (daily): ${maxHolePixels}`); if (maxHolePixels === null || maxHolePixels === undefined) { console.log('C3'); return; } // Convert pixels to area: each pixel at 30km scale = 900 km² const pixelAreaKm2 = 30 * 30; // 900 km² per pixel at 30km resolution const maxHoleAreaKm2 = maxHolePixels * pixelAreaKm2 / 1000000; // convert to millions of km² console.log(`Max ozone hole area 2021: ${(maxHoleAreaKm2).toFixed(2)} million km²`); console.log(`Threshold: 18 million km²`); console.log(`Valid pixels detected: ${maxHolePixels}`); if (maxHolePixels === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } if (maxHoleAreaKm2 >= 18) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
